Neha P.: Hi @people-ops — update: my OPT STEM EAD card renewal is still pending. My manager wants me to start on Jun 1. Can I begin employment if the EAD isn't issued but receipt notice is in hand?
Maria HR: Neha, good question. Receipt notice (I-797C) allows certain employers to continue employment for up to 180 days for EAD renewals in specific categories; need immigration confirmation and payroll doc checklist.
Alyssa (Immigration): Confirming: for STEM EAD renewals we rely on the 180-day automatic extension rule only if category is eligible and the receipt was filed timely. Please DM me a redacted receipt and your current category. If eligible, we can onboard but must keep the case note and reverify once card arrives.
Neha P.: I have the receipt and USCIS case number. Manager wants me fully on payroll on Jun 1 rather than contractor. Any payroll/tax implications?
Sam (Payroll): If you can lawfully work (receipt + eligible category), payroll can add you as employee. But we need I-9: acceptable documents include the receipt for list A temporarily; schedule an in-person I-9 verification once card arrives. Tax withholding depends on your residency status — if still nonresident alien, withholding differs. Provide country of residence at hire.
Maria HR: Benefit enrollment window: employees who start on Jun 1 get 30 days to enroll. If the EAD is issued after start, coverage can be backdated to Jun 1 if enrollment submitted timely. Dependents require valid immigration docs at enrollment — if dependent papers lag, mark dependents as pending and update when available.
Neha P.: I'm currently in the US and will be here for onboarding. I'll upload the receipt to the HR case. If the EAD is denied, what's the fallback?
Alyssa (Immigration): If denied, employment must stop immediately per law. We will escalate to legal and hiring-ops to explore alternative visa options or pause employment. Please keep all USCIS correspondence in the case file.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: upload receipt and case number to https://redwood/hr/cases/neha-opt (HR-2026-5822).
Sam (Payroll): Also note: if you start and later your status changes, payroll needs updated tax forms and possibly amended W-2 handling. We'll flag the case for payroll review at onboarding.
Neha P.: thanks — uploading now. Manager confirmed start contingent on eligible receipt. Appreciate guidance. :smile:
Maria HR: keeping this thread for audit trail. Tag me when receipt uploaded and Alyssa once you DM the redacted docs.
